meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览上游更新,挑选合入定制安装
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果维护着定制版NanoClaw,想便捷同步官方更新
copy.tagline_en: Preview upstream updates and cherry-pick them into your customized install
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized NanoClaw and want to sync official updates

howto.what: 运行 /update-nanoclaw 后,Claude 会先检查你的工作区是否干净,自动备份,再展示上游 NanoClaw 的改动;你可以选合并、挑提交或变基,更新后它会构建测试,并提示你是否有破坏性变更。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 里输入或说出“/update-nanoclaw”时触发;它也适用于你定制过 NanoClaw、想拉取上游更新并保留本地修改的场景。

say.text: 运行 /update-nanoclaw,把上游更新合进来。
say.note: 先备份再合并,保留你的定制。

say.text: 用 /update-nanoclaw 预览上游改动,先别合并。
say.note: 只看改动列表和冲突预览,不修改文件。

howto.what_en: On /update-nanoclaw, Claude verifies a clean tree, backs up, previews upstream changes, then merges/cherry-picks/rebases them into your customized install, validates with build/test, and flags breaking changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /update-nanoclaw in Claude Code, typically after customizing NanoClaw to pull upstream fixes while keeping your local changes.

say_en.note: Backs up first, then merges while keeping your edits.

say_en.text: Use /update-nanoclaw to preview upstream changes only.
say_en.note: Shows logs and conflict preview; changes nothing.

say_en.text: Run /update-nanoclaw in cherry-pick mode for specific commits.
say_en.note: You choose the commits; the rest stays untouched.
